claim: Four PNA homohexamers persist with variable loss; LC-MS peak areas support a bounded chemical-persistence assay.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Tables 2–4; 98% w/w H2SO4; 10 mg/mL; RT 18–25 C; triplicate at 1 h, 24 h, 14 d. Quantitative data transcribed in acid.md.
limitations: Peak-area purity is not absolute concentration. Early nonmonotonic values, unexplained replicate variation, T6 starting purity 75.8%. No copying or duplex test.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Qualitative NMR used deuterated acid plus 10% v/v DMSO-d6; not identical solvent to LC-MS.
confidence_rationale: Original full text and numeric tables inspected through Europe PMC XML; high confidence in transcription, limited kinetic inference.

claim: PNA loss increases markedly at 50 C; all four hexamers fully degraded at 80 C after 24 h.
experimental_or_model_conditions: 98% w/w H2SO4; duplicate LC-MS measurements; Tables 3–4.
limitations: Full degradation has no reported quantitative detection threshold; do not substitute exact zero or fit an Arrhenius law.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Temperature narrows the room-temperature envelope.
confidence_rationale: Direct table observation; no extrapolation to all PNA sequences.

claim: The 20-homodipeptide screen found no member stable beyond five weeks at both tested acid concentrations.
experimental_or_model_conditions: 81/98% w/w D2SO4/D2O; storage 18–24 C, NMR 25 C; 30 mg per 500–700 uL; most briefly heated to 80 C for dissolution.
limitations: Finite sequence set; NMR stability, not fitted half-lives. Preparation heat and isotope substitution matter.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: GG/HH stable four months at 98%; II/PP stable four months at 81%. A06 qualifies broad claims that folding is impossible.
confidence_rationale: Original methods, figures and discussion inspected.

claim: Among 14 alternative bases, six had persistent scaffolds at 98% acid; only benzothiadiazole and bipyridine were soluble and stable at both concentrations.
experimental_or_model_conditions: 81/98% w/w acid; mixed H/D solvents; room temperature, 21 d; screening 25 mg or 25 uL per 840 uL solvent; 2D follow-up at 1/21/39 d.
limitations: No pairing or copying measured. Biphenyl sulfonates; persistent scaffold is not unchanged molecular identity. Solubility failures are not degradation measurements.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Motivated by canonical-base protonation concern from A01; does not resolve it functionally.
confidence_rationale: MIT final-version record plus original full-text PMC12985984 XML inspected.

claim: Mixed single-chain lipids form persistent vesicle-like structures; membrane leakage and selective transport remain unverified.
experimental_or_model_conditions: 70/80/90% v/v nominal acid; equimolar SDS-DTMA 75 mM or SOS-TMO 1 mM; DLS three replicates at 0/1/3/7 d; confocal imaging.
limitations: At 90%, aggregation is heterogeneous and geometry-dependent; moisture gradients possible. v/v cannot equal PNA w/w. QM/MM runs only 125 ps per system.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: 70/80% structures persist over a week; some 90% preparations lose membranous morphology; darkening signals possible reactions.
confidence_rationale: Original full-text methods and results inspected; morphology supported, permeability claim remains computational.

claim: Three selected peptides adopt NMR-constrained omega-loop folds in 98% sulfuric acid.
experimental_or_model_conditions: HHQ 20, HHQ13 12, K7 10.5 mg/mL; 98% w/w H2SO4/H2O; ambient storage, NMR 293 K; HHQ/HHQ13 persist weeks.
limitations: No acid-phase catalytic activity measured. HHQ shows minor changes after a month; K7 changes chemically over weeks, proposed terminal elimination; initial structure uses first three days.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Qualifies A03's broad folding pessimism without contradicting its finite dipeptide measurements; does not establish stability at 81%.
confidence_rationale: Full original article inspected, including methods and structural validation.

claim: Photoactivated elemental sulfur supports abiotic nitrate-to-ammonium conversion in aqueous acidic experiments.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Aqueous pH -0.5 to 0.5; nitrate 10 mM, S0 2 g/L; 254 nm UV; six-hour batch tests, n=3; article-in-press original methods inspected.
limitations: Does not test 98% acid. Sulfur is oxidized to sulfate, requiring replenishment; no integrated carbon fixation or hereditary system.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Ammonium >0.5 mM after six hours; controls lacking S0 do not produce ammonium. Atmospheric extrapolation is a separate model.
confidence_rationale: Primary publisher metadata and original manuscript accessible; final-version detailed methods access was intermittent.

claim: A controlled colloidal memory experiment approached the Landauer mean-heat limit for slow one-bit erasure; this does not specify achievable biological computation.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Bérut et al.; optically driven colloidal particle in a double-well potential, initially equal state populations; reset protocol duration and success rate varied.
limitations: Engineered, externally driven memory; finite-time dissipation and imperfect erasure matter. A reset bound is neither a signaling cost nor a cognitive metric.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Mean heat approached the reference during long cycles; operation-specific conditions prevent generalizing it to every logical step.
confidence_rationale: Direct measurement supports this restricted physical result; no alternative biochemical implementation inferred. Original PDF inspected on 2026-10-06.

claim: Measured blowfly retinal information rates combined with ionic-current accounting imply a photoreceptor cost of about 7 million ATP molecules per transmitted bit under the studied condition.
evidence_type: observed biological function with biophysical energetic estimate
experimental_or_model_conditions: Laughlin et al.; intact blowfly retina information measurements, approximately 1000 bit/s photoreceptor rate and modeled Na/K pump ATP demand.
limitations: Energetics partly inferred; phototransduction costs omitted and natural signal rates may be lower. ATP and retinal channel parameters do not transfer to another solvent.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Estimated ATP demand agreed in order of magnitude with isolated-retina oxygen consumption; costs vary across channels and conditions.
confidence_rationale: Primary methods/results inspected; useful terrestrial channel benchmark, not a universal cost of cognition. Accessed 2026-10-06.

claim: Rat CA1 synapse morphometry supports an estimate of 26 distinguishable strength states, corresponding to about 4.7 bits, under the authors' discrimination assumptions.
evidence_type: observed biological structure with model-derived information estimate
experimental_or_model_conditions: Bartol et al.; serial electron microscopy, shared-axon/shared-dendrite spine pairs; strength inferred from morphology, 69% discrimination criterion.
limitations: Small sampled tissue and proxy for strength; not direct memory write/read, retention or whole-brain capacity measurement.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Changing the discrimination threshold to 76% reduced the estimate to approximately 4.5 bits.
confidence_rationale: Direct structural evidence and transparent inference; extrapolation to human total memory or alternative substrates unsupported. Full text inspected 2026-10-06.

claim: Diffusive arrival and receptor sampling impose noise and integration-time constraints on chemical concentration sensing.
evidence_type: analytical physical model with terrestrial biological comparisons
experimental_or_model_conditions: Berg and Purcell; diffusing ligands and specified cell/receptor geometry; fractional error scaling approximately (D a c tau)^(-1/2).
limitations: Prefactors and optimality depend on sampling, binding, correlations and geometry. Candidate diffusion coefficient and receptor kinetics must be measured.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: The paper compares the analysis with bacterial and slime-mold sensing; it supplies no alternative-solvent signaling rate.
confidence_rationale: Original derivation inspected; useful screening model within assumptions, not evidence for advanced cognition. Accessed 2026-10-06.

claim: Earth transition timing supports long inferred waiting times within the 2020 observer-conditioned Bayesian hard-step model; the result depends on biological assumptions and priors.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Snyder-Beattie et al.; sequential transition model, Earth chronology, habitability horizon and observer selection. Print issue: March 2021.
limitations: One observed biosphere; transition identity, dates and prior bounds are consequential. No candidate-specific chemical rates or independent rerun here.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Oxygen-gated sensitivity analysis already appears in section 4.2. K06 challenges the interpretation of delays through broader environmental history.
confidence_rationale: Original model and environmental sensitivity inspected; conditional inference is reportable, universal abundance conclusions are outside this report. Accessed 2026-10-06.

claim: The 2025 environmental-window reassessment offers a conditional explanation of evolutionary delays without treating each delay as an intrinsically difficult transition.
evidence_type: mechanistic historical hypothesis and critical synthesis
experimental_or_model_conditions: Mills et al.; reexamines evolutionary singularities and changing terrestrial habitability, including oxygen-related opportunities.
limitations: Neither a controlled replay of evolution nor independently measured transition rates. Environmental necessity does not demonstrate sufficiency for cognition.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Alternative interpretation to K05; the 2020 model also considered oxygen-gated rates, so the disagreement extends beyond whether environments change.
confidence_rationale: Original argument inspected; defensible hypothesis requiring independent constraints, with no extrapolated life probability. Accessed 2026-10-06.

claim: Engineered RNA cross-ligases sustain supplied-fragment amplification; fitted growth rates E=0.92 h^-1 and E'=1.05 h^-1.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Fig.2 and preceding paragraphs: 42 C, 25 mM MgCl2, 50 mM EPPS pH8.5; E/E' initially 0.1 uM each; A/A'/B/B' 5.0 uM each; batch 10h. Six 5h reactions, 4% carryover, fresh substrates.
limitations: Preformed sequence-specific activated oligonucleotides and evolved catalysts; no monomer copying, substrate synthesis or organism. Growth constants are fitted logistic parameters, not elementary reaction constants; uncertainty not reported in inspected text.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: >25-fold amplification/5h then substrate plateau; >10^8 cumulative amplification/30h. Separate trimolecular rates 1.3 and0.3 min^-1 are not growth rates.
confidence_rationale: Original manuscript and final PDF agree; manuscript resolves PDF micro-unit extraction errors.

claim: Six XNAs support information recovery with engineered protein polymerases; FANA also showed direct XNA-templated synthesis.
experimental_or_model_conditions: DNA-to-XNA-to-DNA; polymer-specific machinery tabulated in genetics.md. Fig.2–3: 72-residue XNA extension.
limitations: No autonomous machinery production; not six independent organisms.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: HNA binding selection adds function; PCR recovery controls require synthesis and reverse transcription.
confidence_rationale: Original main text and figures inspected through indexed primary-source passages. Supplementary FANA details not separately validated.

claim: 2012 aggregate copying error probabilities vary by backbone: CeNA 0.0043; LNA 0.053 per position.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Full DNA-XNA-DNA cycle; fidelity paragraph referring to TableS8.
limitations: Historical machinery-specific cycle errors, not universal polymer limits or single-step mutation rates.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: HNA/CeNA/ANA/FANA outperform LNA/TNA in this assay.
confidence_rationale: Main-text extrema verified; uninspected SI values omitted.

claim: Later TNA protein-polymerase engineering achieves approximately 1 nucleotide/s and >99% fidelity for enzyme 10-92.
experimental_or_model_conditions: DNA template, TNA triphosphates, protein catalyst engineered from archaeal polymerases; Fig.1 and biochemical analysis. 3'-to-2' product linkage.
limitations: Not TNA self-replication. Conditions/fidelity assay differ from G03; no direct numerical comparison or growth model calibration justified.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Structural and biochemical intermediate analysis supports distinct improvements in fidelity and catalysis; newer machinery invalidates treating 2012 TNA performance as permanent.
confidence_rationale: Original research article inspected, including publication history; headline rate corroborates its cited preceding engineering work, not independently reanalysed raw measurements.

claim: FANA, ANA, HNA and CeNA catalysts cleave RNA, with reported kobs spanning 0.06 to0.0001 min^-1.
experimental_or_model_conditions: 25C; 5uM catalyst/1uM substrate;30mM EPPS pH8.5,150mM KCl,50mM MgCl2; single-turnover kinetics.
limitations: RNA cleavage is neither copying nor population growth.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Scrambled-substrate controls; FANA faster than other tested scaffolds.
confidence_rationale: Full original XML/Methods inspected; rates not reassigned to uninspected individual figure values.

claim: FANA ligase FpImR4_2 joins activated FANA fragments: kobs=0.04 min^-1.
experimental_or_model_conditions: 35C;5uM catalyst,1uM LigS1,5uM LigS2;30mM HEPES pH7.5,150mM KCl,50mM MgCl2,1mM ZnCl2;3'-phosphorylimidazolide activation.
limitations: Single-turnover observed rate; supplied fragments/catalyst, no closed replicator.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: No detectable product without activation/catalyst/second substrate or with splint control. Adapted ligase assembles a different active FANAzyme.
confidence_rationale: Main text/Fig.4/kinetic Methods agree; selection buffer differs and was not substituted.

claim: A selected TNA enzyme catalyses native 3'-5' RNA ligation at 0.39 h^-1 under reported optimal conditions.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Original abstract: Zn2+-dependent; pH7.3,23C; terminal3'-OH and5'-triphosphate RNA substrates.
limitations: Abstract-only access; full metal/buffer concentrations not recovered. Excluded from quantitative pilot parameterization. No TNA self-copying demonstrated.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Functional ribozyme assembled from RNA fragments; extends catalytic evidence beyond the four 2015 XNA backbones.
confidence_rationale: Original indexed abstract and publisher abstract agree; deliberately limited to abstract-reported observations.

claim: Triplet polymerase ribozyme and pH/freeze-thaw cycling permit exponential replication of RNA sequences and a ribozyme fragment.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Methods standard starting buffer:0.4mM MgCl2,1.8mM KCl,1mM CHES pH9,0.01% Tween20,20nM supplied TPR,100nM triplets/primers. Acid/80C2min, neutralize/flash-freeze, -7C about24h; figure-specific compositions differ.
limitations: Fresh reaction mixtures replenish ribozyme and substrates; partial self-copying is not entire catalyst self-maintenance. Rates per cycle, not per hour.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Fig.3e emergent +14nt sequence:1.2-/1.38-fold per cycle for four cycles then plateau. Single long incubation gives lower replication than cycling; salt buildup requires dilution.
confidence_rationale: Original full PDF, Fig.2–4 and Methods inspected; headline open-ended replication kept distinct from autonomous full-ribozyme replication.

claim: 45nt QT45 synthesizes its complementary strand and itself in separate reactions:0.24% and0.17% full-length yields after72days.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Fig.4:8nM primer/template,80nM ribozyme,50nM each substrate;0.01% Tween20,0.4mM MgCl2,1.2mM KCl,1mM CHES pH9;-7C. Positive-strand synthesis adds a defined hexamer and one pH/heat/freeze cycle.
limitations: Separate low-yield reactions, not an autonomous sustained full replication cycle; activated substrates and catalysts supplied. No growth constant established.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Negative-strand products:94.1% mean per-base fidelity,10.9% perfect; positive defined-substrate products:43.4% perfect. Duplex inhibition remains central.
confidence_rationale: Original author manuscript pp.6–8/Fig.4 inspected at https://discovery.ucl.ac.uk/id/eprint/10222270/1/EMS212593.pdf; identities and denominator types distinguished.

claim: Molecular simulations supported mechanically persistent acrylonitrile membranes in methane at 94 K.
correction: 2026-10-13 post-publication review: the archived original ledger reads 90 K; the source paper states a simulation temperature of 94 K.
evidence_type: published computational result (mechanical model; physical validity conditional)
experimental_or_model_conditions: OPLS molecular dynamics and umbrella sampling; cryogenic methane; small organic nitrogen compounds.
limitations: No experimental membrane, metabolism or heredity; persistence of an initialized structure does not establish assembly.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: N02 confirms a local minimum but challenges equilibrium assembly; N03 supplies negative experimental evidence.
confidence_rationale: Primary paper and PubMed record inspected; strong confidence about what was modeled, conditional physical validity.

claim: At 90 K, acrylonitrile azotosome Gibbs energy exceeds molecular Pna21 ice by 8–11 kJ/mol acrylonitrile with methane and 14–17 kJ/mol without methane.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Dispersion-corrected DFT, thermal/entropic corrections, explicit methane environment; reference is molecular ice, not dissolved monomer.
limitations: Range describes DFT-method dependence, not experimental uncertainty. No kinetic rate follows from this energy difference.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Dynamic stability agrees with N01; equilibrium self-assembly is disfavored. N03 favors crystalline alternatives experimentally.
confidence_rationale: Exact values and reference state checked in primary PDF page 2.

claim: Cryogenic calorimetry and Raman experiments detected crystalline behavior rather than azotosome evidence in acrylonitrile/hydrocarbon mixtures.
evidence_type: demonstrated chemical subsystem / negative assembly test
experimental_or_model_conditions: 10 wt% mixtures with methane or ethane; cooled to 94 K, held 24 h, heated at 0.15 K/min. Ethane cocrystal assignment, dissociation near 166 K; methane showed no discernible comparable interaction.
limitations: Finite preparation, observation time and detection methods; does not exclude every hydrocarbon compartment or driven assembly route.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Supports N02's competing crystalline-state concern while extending it experimentally.
confidence_rationale: Full primary Results and Methods inspected; cocrystal remains the authors' structural interpretation.

claim: Perfluoroalkyl amides show concentration-dependent micelle-type aggregation and ester-ammonolysis catalysis in liquid ammonia.
experimental_or_model_conditions: 19F NMR aggregation assay; chain-length-dependent critical aggregation; reported Klevens parameters A=0.18, B=0.19.
limitations: Engineered fluorinated feedstocks; micelles are not reproducing cells; no genetic system or ammonia-water compatibility envelope demonstrated.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: N05 independently supports selected organic catalysis in ammonia, but shared operating conditions remain to be tested.
confidence_rationale: Primary abstract and author conference abstract inspected; publisher full-text access failed, so no additional kinetic constant is asserted.

claim: Immobilized Candida antarctica lipase B catalyzes selective triglyceride ammonolysis in pure liquid ammonia, including trioleate at 25 °C.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Immobilized CALB; triglycerides yield amides and glycerol; triacetate versus tributyrate gives different ester-cleavage selectivity.
limitations: Supplied Earth enzyme and support; native insoluble lipase showed no enzyme-catalyzed reaction. Exact pressure and hydration are not extracted from the accessible abstract.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Shows ammonia can host selected catalysis; cannot establish an autonomous ammonia biochemistry.
confidence_rationale: Author institutional primary-article record inspected; doi:10.1002/poc.3583; month is issue date.

claim: Cholesterol oxidase catalysis in supercritical CO2 depends strongly on hydration and substrate aggregation; bone-dry medium sharply reduces oxidation.
experimental_or_model_conditions: High-pressure EPR; cholesterol oxidase, cholesterol, molecular oxygen; dry versus water-saturated CO2 and organic dopants.
limitations: Earth protein and hydration supplied; no independent genetic or metabolic system. Exact temperature-pressure range not extracted from abstract.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Companion primary report https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/17836870/ (1988-01-22) demonstrates activity and dopant/pressure effects.
confidence_rationale: Primary abstracts inspected; strong support for limited catalysis, no basis for water-free organisms.

claim: An evolved cytochrome c catalyzes C–Si formation with >1500 turnovers and >99% enantiomeric excess for the benchmark reaction.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Rma cytochrome c V75T/M100D/M103E; heat-treated E. coli lysate; silane and diazo ester; pH7.4 buffer, room temperature, anaerobic, dithionite, 5 vol% acetonitrile.
limitations: Carbon-based protein machinery and selected synthetic substrates; not silicon-dominant life or natural organosilicon metabolism.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Initial turnover frequency reported as 46/min; product scope exceeds one C–Si compound.
confidence_rationale: Full primary paper inspected, including experimental figure captions; date is online publication, issue 2016-12-02.

claim: Polysilane Si–Si chains undergo photodegradation; their behavior must not be conflated with siloxane Si–O–Si backbones or silica networks.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Trefonas, West and Miller, Polysilane high polymers: mechanism of photodegradation, JACS107:2737–2742.
limitations: Publisher metadata/first-page access only; no quantitative rate or universal environmental exclusion extracted.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: 2020 review doi:10.3390/life10060084 organizes solvent-dependent Si chemistry but is secondary evidence, not a demonstration of silicon-dominant heredity.
confidence_rationale: Primary title, authors and date verified; narrowly scoped material claim only.

claim: A trapped Mo36-centered intermediate and seed-addition experiments support templated assembly of a 3.6-nm Mo150 oxide wheel.
experimental_or_model_conditions: Flow synthesis and crystallographic intermediate; template expelled upon further reduction; added template accelerates assembly and increases yield.
limitations: Template-mediated assembly does not demonstrate sequence copying or Darwinian heredity.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: N10 extends assembly evidence with autocatalytic kinetics in 2020.
confidence_rationale: Primary abstract inspected; no numeric acceleration inferred.

claim: Mo36 formation shows sigmoidal kinetics and seed-dependent lag removal in acidic water.
experimental_or_model_conditions: 24.3 °C, pH~1.7, 350-nm absorbance; 1.6e-3 M seed stock. Lower acidity slows assembly; strong reduction produces decomposition within 1 s.
limitations: No transmitted functional variants demonstrated. Main-text stock versus final concentration conventions require SI resolution before quantitative reaction simulation.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Supports N09; recognition inhibitors and seeding distinguish mechanism beyond sigmoid alone.
confidence_rationale: Full primary article inspected; abstract mislabels Mo36 formula, while Fig1 correctly gives [Mo36O112(H2O)16]8−.

claim: Published Mo-oxide Monte Carlo rates are phenomenological assumptions rather than measured elementary constants.
evidence_type: published computational result (qualitative predictions compared with spectroscopy)
experimental_or_model_conditions: Mass-action stochastic assembly model; assumed 10-fold template enhancement and additional assembly-bias parameter.
limitations: Cannot convert model time directly to physical replication rates; hypothesized Mo36-to-Mo6 catalysis was not directly resolved.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Model predicts qualitative cluster coexistence subsequently tested spectroscopically.
confidence_rationale: Methods explicitly state missing rate estimates and phenomenological construction.

claim: Designed boron/nitrogen replacements of carbon in DNA components support computed base pairing and short double-helical structures.
evidence_type: published computational result (selected quantum-method crosschecks; no experimental validation)
experimental_or_model_conditions: ωB97XD/aug-cc-pVDZ, selected MP2/CCSD/SAPT comparisons; 2- and 6-base-pair fragments; isoelectronic substitutions and deliberate hydrogen adjustments.
limitations: No synthesis, environmental lifetime, polymerization, template copying, mutation or autonomous function demonstrated; structural resemblance is insufficient for genetic function.
supporting_or_conflicting_results: Publisher first-publication date is Jan3; PubMed issue/article metadata reports Jan29. No experimental validation located in this bounded search.
confidence_rationale: Primary methods, abstract and publisher date inspected; confidence applies to reported calculation, not viable BN genetics.
